result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign or DocuSign**\. However, the best choice depends on whether you primarily need to collect signatures or manage the entire contract and sales-document process.

Here are the platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — Best overall for simplicity**

(My top pick for straightforward signing)

- Easy to set up and use.
- Reusable templates and signing reminders.
- Good for client agreements, NDAs, and service contracts.
- Integrates with Dropbox and other business tools.
  
  Pricing starts around \$15/month annually; check sending limits and team requirements.
  
  [Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Account: Docusign Inc](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dVhOhGt1QpkndwtGW47-sHNKllomPpU4vxs24pNswQkR4ZS5Rob9EH7Az_JSTVPfQ9TrCcH0e5oK9YdRNpm6RmBNsVkzxCsRHsY0XVby2paTjfNsyLWxXQIwIgoVkcHAN04Sy6nvt4MWYDJyoVDMUxLCH1igYXq2J2nv9XGNpFZ1f102xwVUVNokEDaHEjlQ?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — Best for professional business contracts**

- Widely recognized by customers and business partners.
- Excellent document tracking and audit trails.
- Large integration ecosystem.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.
  
  Entry plans around \$11/month; more useful business plans cost more and have sending limits.
  
  [DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc — Best for sales and proposals**

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Collect signatures and payments.
- Reusable document templates.
- CRM integrations.
  
  Paid plans start around \$19/user/month annually; limited free signing is available.
  
  [PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Adobe Acrobat Sign — Best for PDF workflows**

- Sign and manage PDF documents.
- Useful if you already use Adobe Acrobat.
- Document editing and signing in one ecosystem.
  
  Plans start around \$16.99/license/month for eligible team plans.
  
  [Adobe Acrobat Sign website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. signNow — Best budget option**

- Straightforward electronic signatures.
- Document templates and automated workflows.
- Attractive pricing for smaller teams.
  
  Starts around \$8/user/month annually, with annual sending limits to check.
  
  [signNow website](https://www.signnow.com/)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best for | Main advantage |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Small businesses | Simple, easy signing |
| DocuSign | Established businesses | Recognition and integrations |
| PandaDoc | Sales teams | Proposals + signatures |
| Adobe Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | PDF editing + signing |
| signNow | Budget-conscious teams | Lower starting cost |


Pricing and feature comparisons are based on 2026 published comparisons; verify current plan limits before purchasing. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[serpastra.com](https://serpastra.com/blog/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business\:

- **1–5 employees\:** Dropbox Sign.
- **Professional client contracts\:** DocuSign.
- **Sales proposals and customer agreements\:** PandaDoc.
- **Lowest-cost option\:** signNow.

One important consideration: check whether the subscription limits the number of documents you can send. A cheap plan can become expensive once your business starts sending contracts regularly.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation if I know what kind of business you're running.

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
